description: 'The endurance classic up to 30MPa'; very high wear resistance on (almost) all shafts, also rough/soft shafts and abrasive media; very high service life; low coefficient of friction; lubrication- and maintenance-free; dirt-resistant. Base polymer/fillers not published.
notes: Density and colour (yellow) from the igus data sheet (2005 and 19.11.2013 issues, identical); current igus.ca 'iglide L280' page (Canadian name of W300) gives 1.24 g/cm3, 507,600 psi (=3500 MPa), 18,130 psi (=125 MPa), Shore D 77. The '30MPa' in the headline is the usage recommendation; the mechanical max recommended surface pressure is 60 MPa (page diagram 02: '60MPa at +20C'). Axial securing needed above +60 C. Short-term ambient 200 C per data sheet. Modulus is the FLEXURAL modulus (DIN 53457); igus product pages label it 'Modulus of elasticity', US/Canada pages give it in psi. Strength is FLEXURAL strength at +20 C (DIN 53452); igus.com/igus.ca label the same number 'tensile strength'. Max recommended surface pressure = 'max. permissible static surface pressure' (mechanical limit at +20 C, not a tribological rating). Compressive strength, CTE, conductivity and temperatures from the current igus.eu product-detail page (embedded attribute data) and material-data page.
